episodes.name: To Me, My X-Men
episodes.overviewEn: Cyclops races to find the source of new anti-mutant technology.
episodes.overviewAr: يسارع "سايكلوب" لإيجاد مصدر تكنولوجيا مضادة للمتحولين.

episodes.name: Mutant Liberation Begins
episodes.overviewEn: When Magneto is forced by the UN to stand trial, a group of anti-mutant rioters test his resolve.
episodes.overviewAr: حين تُجبر الأمم المتحدة "ماغنيتو" على الخضوع للمحاكمة، تختبر قلّة مشاغبة من مناهضي المتحولين عزيمته.

episodes.name: Fire Made Flesh
episodes.overviewEn: The team is propelled into a tragic confrontation with an immortal mad scientist.
episodes.overviewAr: يُدفع الفريق إلى مواجهة مأساوية مع عالم مجنون خالد.

episodes.name: Motendo / Lifedeath (1)
episodes.overviewEn: Jubilee must relive the X-Men's greatest adventures when she's transported into a 16-bit video game.
episodes.overviewAr: يتعين على "جوبيلي" عيش أعظم مغامرات "إكس من" من جديد عندما تُنقل إلى لعبة فيديو بنظام 16 بت.

episodes.name: Remember It
episodes.overviewEn: Team members hit Genosha as UN honorees while a press event risks exposing the team's dirty laundry.
episodes.overviewAr: يذهب أعضاء الفريق إلى "غينوشا" لتكرّمهم الأمم المتحدة بينما يهدد حدث صحفي بفضح أسرار الفريق القذرة.

episodes.name: Lifedeath (2)
episodes.overviewEn: Storm is forced to face her worst fears in order to free herself.
episodes.overviewAr: تُجبر "ستورم" على مواجهة أسوأ مخاوفها كي تحرر نفسها.

episodes.name: Bright Eyes
episodes.overviewEn: The X-Men finds Sentinel inventor Bolivar Trask, realizing they've been played by a mastermind.
episodes.overviewAr: يجد فريق "إكس من" مخترع الحرّاس الآليين "بوليفار تراسك"، ويدركون أن هناك من تلاعب بهم.

episodes.name: Tolerance Is Extinction (1)
episodes.overviewEn: The X-Men must unite to face a new threat.
episodes.overviewAr: يجب على "إكس من" أن يتحدوا لمواجهة تهديد جديد.

episodes.name: Tolerance Is Extinction (2)
episodes.overviewEn: The X-Men work to settle the score before it is too late.
episodes.overviewAr: يعمل "إكس من" على تسوية الأمور قبل فوات الأوان.

episodes.name: Tolerance Is Extinction (3)
episodes.overviewEn: The X-Men's dream is put to the test as mutant-human relations reach a tipping point.
episodes.overviewAr: يتعرّض حلم "إكس من" للاختبار مع وصول علاقة المتحولين والبشر إلى نقطة اللاعودة.

episodes.name: Days of Past Future
episodes.overviewEn: Forge and Bishop launch an ambitious plan to rescue the X-Men who have been scattered through time.

episodes.name: A Force to Be Reckoned With
episodes.overviewEn: After E-Day, a covert paramilitary force rises to try to fill the void left by the X-Men.

episodes.name: Rise of Apocalypse (1)
episodes.overviewEn: The plan to rescue the team from Ancient Egypt is turned upside-down by an unexpected visitor.

episodes.name: Rise of Apocalypse (2)
episodes.overviewEn: An alliance between the X-Men and En Sabah Nur starts to crack when Rama-Tut seeks ultimate power.

episodes.name: Weapon X, Lies, and DVDs
episodes.overviewEn: Wolverine, Morph, and a motley crew of old rivals face off against Weapon X's latest experiment.

episodes.name: Danger.Exe
episodes.overviewEn: Former X-Man Polaris returns to Xavier's mansion just as a new threat emerges on campus.

episodes.name: Strange Land, Savage Heart
episodes.overviewEn: The X-Men travel to the Savage Land and are surprised to find a familiar face.

episodes.name: The Dead Man's Hand
episodes.overviewEn: The X-Men confront a ghost from their past.

episodes.name: Survival of the Fittest
episodes.overviewEn: The X-Men are pushed to their limits as their past comes back to haunt them.
